LIC Policy Revival in 2026: Complete Step-by-Step Guide to Revive Your Lapsed Policy

2026-06-28 By Hari Kotian

LIC Policy Revival: How to Revive Your Lapsed LIC Policy in 2026 (Complete Guide)

Reviving a lapsed LIC policy is easier than most policyholders think. If your LIC policy has lapsed due to non-payment of premiums, you can typically revive it within 5 years of the lapse period without undergoing a fresh medical examination in most cases.

What Happens When Your LIC Policy Lapses?

When you stop paying premiums on your LIC policy, it enters a "lapsed" status after the grace period (usually 30 days for annual premiums, 15 days for half-yearly/quarterly). During the lapse period:

- You lose all insurance coverage

- The policy's surrender value remains frozen

- You cannot take policy loans against the lapsed policy

- Your accumulated bonus (if any) is forfeited upon revival

LIC Policy Revival Rules 2026

Revival Period

You can revive a lapsed LIC policy within **5 consecutive years** from the date of first unpaid premium. After 5 years, the policy cannot be revived and you lose all benefits.

Revival Methods

1. Ordinary Revival

- Pay all outstanding premiums with interest

- Interest rate: Currently 10% p.a. for most policies (check your policy document)

- No fresh medical examination required if lapse is within 5 years and sum assured is below ₹25 lakh

2. Special Revival

- Available for certain endowment and money-back policies

- Allows revival with reduced paid-up value

- Lower premium burden compared to ordinary revival

3. Installment Revival

- Pay the arrears in installments instead of lump sum

- Available for policies with sum assured above ₹1 lakh

Step-by-Step LIC Policy Revival Process

Step 1: Check Your Policy Status

Visit the LIC website (licindia.in) or use the LIC mobile app to check your policy status. You can also call LIC customer care at 022-6789 7777.

Step 2: Calculate Outstanding Amount

Use the LIC premium calculator or visit your nearest LIC branch to get the exact amount due including:

- Unpaid premiums for the lapse period

- Accrued interest on unpaid premiums

- Any applicable taxes

Step 3: Gather Required Documents

- Original policy document

- Latest premium receipt (if available)

- Identity proof (Aadhaar, PAN)

- Address proof

- Bank account details for ECS mandate

- Medical reports (if required)

Step 4: Visit LIC Branch or Apply Online

Online:

Log in to LIC customer portal → Policy Services → Revival Request

Offline:

Visit nearest LIC branch with documents and revival application form

Step 5: Pay Revival Amount

Pay the outstanding amount through:

- LIC online payment portal

- Demand draft at LIC branch

- NEFT/RTGS to LIC account

Step 6: Get Revival Confirmation

Once processed (usually 7-15 working days), you'll receive a revival confirmation letter. Your policy is active again!

Important Tips for LIC Policy Revival

1. **Act quickly** — The longer you wait, the more interest accumulates

2. **Check for bonuses** — Some policies allow revival with proportionate bonus restoration

3. **Medical requirements** — If you're over 45 or have had health issues since the lapse, a fresh medical exam may be required

4. **Tax benefits** — Once revived, you can claim Section 80C benefits on premiums paid for revival

5. **Surrender value** — If revival seems expensive, compare with taking a new policy — sometimes it's cheaper to start fresh

Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Waiting beyond 5 years (policy becomes permanently dead)

- Not checking if revival is financially viable vs. new policy

- Ignoring the interest component (can be substantial for long lapses)

- Not updating nominee details during revival

FAQ

Q: Can I revive my LIC policy after 3 years of lapse?

Yes, you can revive within 5 years of the first unpaid premium. After 3 years, you'll pay 3 years of unpaid premiums plus interest.

Q: Do I need a medical test for LIC policy revival?

Not always. If the lapse is within 5 years and sum assured is below ₹25 lakh, most policies don't require fresh medical exams. However, LIC may require health declarations.

Q: What is the interest rate for LIC policy revival?

Currently around 10% p.a. for most traditional plans. Check with LIC for the exact rate applicable to your policy.

Q: Can I revive my LIC policy online?

Yes, through the LIC customer portal if you have an account. Log in → Policy Services → Revival → Follow the prompts.

Q: How long does LIC policy revival take?

Typically 7-15 working days after payment and document submission. Complex cases may take longer.

Conclusion

Reviving a lapsed LIC policy is almost always better than letting it die — you preserve the original premium rates, bonus accumulation, and tax benefits.
